selected.title: Revolut launches personal loans in the UK
selected.summary: Revolut is stepping up its challenge to the UK's high street banks with the introduction of a personal loan product.
selected.why: Revolut expands into UK consumer lending with the launch of personal loans.

reason: Revolut's UK personal loans expand fintech into credit risk; argues whether non-banks should hold consumer lending risk or partner with regulated lenders
angle: Fintech lenders should hold their own credit risk rather than outsource it to prove they can manage underwriting as competently as banks do.
